description: This file contains culture-specific information for the Quechua (Bolivia) locale used in date parsing and formatting in the DateJS library. It defines arrays of day and month names in Quechua, formats, regex patterns for parsing, and prototype methods for date manipulation tailored to this locale.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components (hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds) of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time components of a Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current Date object with another date, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week from its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month from its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a given year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
